_doc: Every number the engine uses, with where it comes from. 'source' = checked against a page; 'estimate' = our judgement, open to revision.

meters_per_unit.why: terrain is projected from real coordinates: OSM coastline + SRTM 30 m elevation, origin lon 28.884 / lat 41.058, map 14.4 x 9.6 km

wall_gap_m.note: Constantine's wall ~2.8 km (15 stadia) west of the Severan wall; Theodosian walls ~2 km further west

population_330.note: one study gives ~30,000 in 330 and ~300,000 by 450

population_450.note: Growing Up in Constantinople (2015) via search; mid-5th c. urban area ~1,400 ha

grain_dole_332.note: 80,000 rations a day from 117 distribution points

people_per_house.why: house footprint 10-16 m, 2-3 storeys; at ~50% built cover gives ~260 people/ha, inside the 100-400/ha range of dense pre-industrial cities

growth_cap_per_decade.why: historic average 330-450 is ~21%/decade (x10 in 120 years); booms run faster, so the cap sits above the average

food.why: two harbors + one granary ~ 80,000, the size of the 332 grain dole

water.why: wells and rain for a small town; a full aqueduct system supports a metropolis of hundreds of thousands

terrain.coastline: OpenStreetMap natural=coastline via Overpass, 2026-10-09 (modern shoreline, includes landfill)
terrain.landmarks: placed at real lat/lon: Milion, Hagia Sophia/Irene, Hippodrome, Forum of Constantine, Binbirdirek, Kumkapi, Sirkeci, Severan & Constantinian wall lines (approx.)
